name: Decal_Burn_Scorch_03
class: decal (alpha decal texture set; no mesh)

textures.channels: base colour sRGB + opacity in alpha
tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (0)

material_exception: decal set private to this decal; a deferred decal cannot use the tiling library sets of ART_STANDARD.md section 2
source_note: the source is the height field generated by the build script (seeded, deterministic); the .blend holds the review scene with the decal blended over the ground
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this decal dresses the placements that show frame 158/3
dresses: two overlapping burns on a diagonal, about 1.1 m end to end, sharing one soot halo
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A flat decal: the burnt-through middle is a black patch with a normal-map lip, not a hole, so it cannot show the joists or the depth below that the original frame hints at. The char blocks follow one grain direction (decal X); rotate the decal to the planks it sits on. Soot halo opacity assumes a mid-toned floor. Unreal decal material is not built here.
